decisions.reason: The lighting-around-the-bowls effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Silver applies to the decorative buttons and knobs, not the established beige body, beige support base, or green accents.
The message discusses decorative controls and possible K markings on buttons, not the support-base logo or lettering.
The candidate already requires K markings, while the client's desire to explore the earlier idea establishes no necessary change to the existing text, style, coverage, or color.
The warning about AI-rendered proportions does not establish a new bowl size, capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraint.
The decorative-control and visual-design decision does not change splash prevention or mitigation behavior.
The request for measuring units around the bowls reiterates the candidate's existing marking style and placement without changing its state.
Liking the rendered power button does not necessarily change the established functional control type or its front-panel location.
The message specifies decorative appearance for buttons and knobs but does not alter the established placement of speed, dispense, or master-power controls.
The client acknowledges that AI-rendered proportions may be unmanufacturable but provides no replacement dimensions or necessary change to the accepted bulkier form.
The visual styling decision has no effect on whisk removal, bowl clearance, cleaning, or part-swapping behavior.
The message does not change the machine placard's wording, position, duplication, or viewing orientations.
